subject.title: [Bug]: --to flag ignored when using --agent with custom channel, all sessions map to main

question: Should the fix for explicit `--agent --channel --to` routing use raw recipient-derived session keys, a bounded/opaque recipient-key contract, or compatibility migration before merge?
rationale: The bug is valid, but the remaining implementation choice affects persisted session identity, customer-context isolation, and whether recipient identifiers are stored or forwarded in session keys.

options.title: Refresh With Bounded/Opaque Keys
options.body: Refresh or replace the open PR on current main, preserve `--session-key` and `--session-id` precedence, and use a bounded or maintainer-approved opaque recipient key contract.

options.title: Accept Raw Recipient Keys
options.body: Land raw channel/recipient-derived keys only after tests and PR text make the persisted identifier contract explicit and accepted.

options.title: Pause For Compatibility Design
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide whether existing main-session rows need migration or an accepted break.

recommendation.title: Refresh With Bounded/Opaque Keys
recommendation.body: Refresh or replace the open PR on current main, preserve `--session-key` and `--session-id` precedence, and use a bounded or maintainer-approved opaque recipient key contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the current open fix path and has recent merged history in the same resolver boundary.
